title: During conscious states the two compartments are coupled

statements.text: Global conscious integration depends on local integration within single layer 5 pyramidal neurons. During conscious states their apical and basal compartments are coupled, which lets information flow through thalamo-cortical and cortico-cortical connections and enables system-wide integration.

sources.quote: it is proposed that global conscious integration also depends on local integration on the level of single layer 5 pyramidal neurons
during conscious states, these two compartments are coupled, i.e., integrated
